Lawson is a chain of convenience stores that operate 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
We sell a variety of products including tasty food, drinks, and cosmetics. ATMs are also available in stores for
        convenience, and tax-free purchases can be made at tax-free stores. We look forward to your patronage.
Products
Payment
TaxFree
Updates
Service
Recommended products
Introducing choice sweets and recommended products from Lawson. Be sure to
          check them out when you visit our stores.
KARAAGE-KUN Fried Chicken (comes with 5 pieces, available in various flavors)
“KARAAGE-KUN Fried Chicken” and “KARAAGE-KUN Fried Chicken, Hot” are our beloved classic flavors of
                KARAAGE-KUN Fried Chicken, first sold in 1986. Other time-limited flavors are also released from time to
                time.
MACHI café Café Latte (M)
Lawson’s MACHI café coffee and Café Latte are freshly brewed in-store with care.
PREMIUM ROLL CAKE
Savor 100% fresh cream to your heart’s content!
DORAYAKI
Chewy dough filled with delicious sweet red bean paste and cream.
MILK CREAM CAKE ROLL
Made with delightfully chewy cake dough! A cake roll filled with whipped cream.
*“Mochi texture roll (milk cream)” is sold in the Okinawa area instead.
Tuna Mayonnaise
A perfect balance between tuna and mayonnaise despite the strong tuna taste.
Thick Pork Cutlet Sandwich
With pork cutlets fried in-store for a tender texture!
Be sure to try these sandwiches at Lawson stores with Machikado Chubo in-store kitchens.
*For some stores, food is prepared at a separate nearby store instead. See
here
for Lawson stores with
                Machikado Chubo in-store kitchens. (This page is only available in Japanese.)
[Things to note regarding products]
KARAAGE-KUN Fried Chicken (comes with 5 pieces, available in various flavors) is not available at NATURAL LAWSON.
Be sure to check products for information on allergies before making your purchase.
The nutritional values of products may differ between regions. Please check the product packaging labels.
Images are for illustration purposes only. Actual products may differ from the images.
Certain products may not be available in some stores or regions.
Depending on the region, the sale of certain products may end without prior notice.
Available payment methods
and ATM
At Lawson stores, payment can be made via credit cards, barcode payment
          apps, and e-money.
Credit cards
Credit card installment payment is not accepted.
A signature or PIN entry is not required for credit card payments for
                    amounts less than 10,000 yen.
A signature or PIN entry is required for credit card payments for
                    amounts of 10,000 yen or more.
Credit cards cannot be used when purchasing telephone cards, bus cards,
                    train tickets, coupon tickets, product vouchers, QUO cards, stamps, postcards, or revenue stamps, or
                    when paying for certain Loppi services, utility bills, or convenience store payment for products.
Your credit card limit per transaction depends on your contract with
                    your credit card company and your usage conditions.
Multiple credit cards cannot be used in one transaction.
Use of certain credit cards may not be possible even if their credit
                    card brand is listed as accepted
A processing fee may be charged by your card issuing company.

                accepted.
24/7 withdrawal of Japanese yen is available at Lawson ATMs using overseas-issued cards.
Visa, MasterCard, JCB, and UnionPay cards are accepted.
Accepted cards may differ depending on the ATM.
The ATM transaction screen can be displayed in English, Simplified
                    Chinese, and Korean.
For information on stores with ATMs that you can use, service details, and
                    how to use the ATMs, please check the following special website.
Click

Tax-free
Please see the following for information on tax-free purchases at Lawson
          stores.
TAX-FREE Guide (PDF)
Tax exemption notes
Please check the following points to note and check the electronic pamphlet for details before making
              tax-free purchases.
The hours during which tax-free purchases can be made may differ between the
                following tax-free stores.
Tax-free purchasing provides an exemption from consumption tax.
Tax-free purchasing is available only for the following individuals.
[Non-Japanese persons]
Non-residents on a short-stay visa, diplomatic visa, or official visa who have been in Japan for less than six months and who have proof of a landing permission seal.
Persons who are able to present their passport. (Tax-free purchasing with Visit Japan Web is not supported.)
[Japanese citizens]
Non-residents who have been living overseas for two or more years and who can show proof of this with a residency certificate or a copy of their family register with their address history. *Please bring an original copy.
Must have last entered Japan within the last six months.
Persons who are able to present their passport.
[Eligibility conditions]
Purchases must cost at least 5,000 yen (excluding tax) to be eligible for tax exemption.
Gift cards, stamps, Loppi merchandise, products paid for through payment service providers, frozen foods, products with lids that cannot be sealed tightly, and other products that cannot be sealed in the specified packaging are not eligible.
Purchases of 500,000 yen or more made on the same day at the same store are not eligible for tax exemption.
After purchasing, you must not open the product packaging or use the products until you leave Japan.
Products must not have been purchased for commercial purposes or to resell.
Products can be purchased using cash, credit cards, barcode payment apps, or other payment methods, but consumption tax refunds will be offered in cash only.
